RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel selecting a female candidate is not evidence of discrimination. A department head role heavily emphasizes administrative leadership, where the successful candidate’s dedicated management training and broad leadership experience likely aligned better with the hospital’s strategic priorities than purely technical or academic qualifications.

Raising sex discrimination based solely on the panel's gender composition is speculative and risks damaging your professional standing. Furthermore, a two-week wait for written feedback is typical in hospital HR processes. 

Instead of raising bias, send a polite follow-up inquiry regarding your feedback request. Use the debrief to understand their evaluation criteria objectively before making any assumptions.
